data.name: Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD2D
data.detailed_description:
Three Kingdoms: The Legend of Zhuge Kongming HD-2D is an HD-2D turn-based RPG inspired by the legendary era of the Three Kingdoms.

Lead famous heroes such as Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang through a land divided by war and ambition. Relive epic historical events, recruit powerful generals, and build an army capable of changing the fate of the realm.

Combining nostalgic pixel art with modern lighting and visual effects, the game delivers a classic RPG experience with a fresh HD-2D presentation.

Features:

■ Classic Turn-Based Battles
Strategically command your party and troops in traditional RPG combat.

■ Epic Three Kingdoms Story
Experience a grand historical journey inspired by one of China's most celebrated eras.

■ Recruit Legendary Generals
Gather famous warriors and strategists, each with unique strengths and abilities.

■ Equipment and Strategy Systems
Customize your army through equipment, formations, and tactical decisions.

■ Beautiful HD-2D Visuals
Enjoy a blend of retro pixel art and modern lighting technology.

Forge your own legend in the age of heroes and war.

data.short_description: This HD-2D role-playing game pays tribute to the beloved Three Kingdoms RPGs of the classic console era. Follow the journey of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Zhuge Liang as you recruit legendary heroes, travel across ancient China, and experience a grand tale of war, loyalty, and ambition.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 460 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
